authorized_scope: Bounded native autonomous-return, Z/K conditional, conductance-response gate and structural-control campaign; candidate Figure 5 delivery.

mechanism.interpretation: Global-response dynamics and K suppression create low activity. Raw G must also decline because it contributes to Z resource load. Z then recovers while K decays; short-event return follows later. K alone does not determine a stochastic first-event time.

conditional_interpretation: Finite 30 s responses, final 10 s readouts; Z/K held spatial fields, dynamic G/M. These are not autonomous loops or certified attractors.
structural_interpretation: At high Z and low K, current/isotropic graphs permit separated brief events with positive unclamped-law Z drift; rotated graph has persistent propagation and negative Z drift. Outdegree, low-threshold source output and anisotropy magnitude are not all matched, so pure orientation causality is not established.
agent_visual_review: All 34 conditional cases, new native cases, main candidates and final comparison maps reviewed; main figures/maps include same-state PDF review.
limits: One paired future noise realization for new structural controls; four source returns are not four seeds.
Grid does not enclose actual first entry/exit; no interpolated complete boundaries.
Projection return is not a certified limit cycle.
Strong core recruitment does not prove every event initiates in a core.
Contact-current proxy and old patient panel do not validate new clinical spectral correspondence.
